observations: I read assets/panels/04-2.png against nurse.png and main-cast.png. The nurse matches her sheet: chin-length wavy dark bob with a side part, wide bright eyes, thick straight brows, lavender scrubs, purple lanyard with a blank white card, white clinic shoes, and the watch on her left wrist. Ravi matches his sheet in face (beard, brows, creased eyes), clothing and watch.

Ravi sits at the lower left on a teal chair, relaxed and smiling at the nurse. His left arm (the arm on the shirt-pocket side, with the watch) rests on the side table with a dark BP cuff on the upper arm and a pulse oximeter clipped on a front fingertip. His right hand rests on his knee, as the production notes specify.

The nurse stands at the right, smiling and speaking. Her upper hand holds the black inflation bulb. Her lower hand, with the watch (her left), lightly steadies the tube. This matches production (right hand on the bulb, left hand on the tube). The tubing runs plausibly from the cuff to the monitor and the bulb.
The small monitor shows only an abstract wave and a blank pill shape, with no numbers or readings.
Ravi's brown shoulder bag stands on the floor beside his chair at the lower left, matching the 'on the floor' step. It is still on the floor in 05-1 and 06-2 and back on his shoulder in 07-1.

At the right, the reception counter with its teal front, a monitor, a plant and a teal waiting chair are visible, so the corner reads as beside reception. The upper third is plain wall for the caption and balloon.

Note on the record, not the art: the production 'after' field for shoulder-bag says 'back on his shoulder as he walks in (05-1)'. In the actual 05-1 he is already seated with the bag on the floor beside his chair. The wording should read 'on the floor during the consultation, back on his shoulder at reception (07-1)'. The art is consistent, so I am not raising this as an artwork issue.
